notes.title: Patch 0.3 – Bugfix Update
notes.content: [h1]Patch 0.3 – Bugfix Update[/h1][p]More stable, fairer, less frustration — focused on fixes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]Inventory/Power-Ups: After clicking one power-up, all others lock for 20 seconds; Health & Ammo remain available. Auto-unlocks after 20s.[/p][p]Elevators: Fixed behavior — they now reliably go down to the floor for clean boarding.[/p][p]Level´s: Corrected breakable box drop logic (unintentionally low chances in corridors).[/p][p][/p][p]Minor Adjustments[/p][p]Level´s: Previously empty corridors now include Health and Ammo pickups.[/p][p][/p][h2]Links[/h2][p]Website: [url="https://www.vertexvienna.at/"]https://www.vertexvienna.at/[/url][/p][p]Youtube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/@Vertex.Vienna"]https://www.youtube.com/@Vertex.Vienna[/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.2 – Bonus Level: Text Update
notes.content: [h1]Patch 0.2 – Bonus Level: Text Update[/h1][p]Bonus doors now give immediate feedback as soon as you touch them.[/p][p][/p][h2]New[/h2][p]When touching \[b]Bonus Doors\[/b], a \[b]text message\[/b] now appears (configurable in the Inspector).[/p][p][/p][h2]Links[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Webseit: [/b][url="https://www.vertexvienna.at/"]VertexVienna[/url][/p][p][b]Youtube: [/b][url="https://www.youtube.com/@Vertex.Vienna"]VertexVienna[/url][/p]
